# ruby — Gemfile.lock is the real rails/rails lockfile (Bundler 4, CHECKSUMS
# section with per-artifact sha256, PATH/GIT sources, platform-variant gems).
# rake from its GEM specs (no licence there); mygem from a .gemspec, whose
# `s.licenses` is mined offline by the manifest enricher.
purl pkg:gem/rake@13.3.0
cpe  cpe:2.3:a:rake:rake:13.3.0:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
# nokogiri appears five times in the lock (ruby + four platform builds); the
# platform suffix strips to one purl, proving the variant handling end to end.
purl pkg:gem/nokogiri@1.19.1
cpe  cpe:2.3:a:nokogiri:nokogiri:1.19.1:*:*:*:*:*:*:*
purl pkg:gem/mygem@2.0.0
